info.name: PulseForge API & Realtime (Laravel 13)
info.description:
Ready-to-run Postman collection for PulseForge (Multi-Tenant Incident Management, Health Monitoring, Stripe Billing, Session & Google OAuth Authentication, and Laravel Reverb Realtime WebSockets).

Default Docker Host Ports:
- App / API (Nginx): http://localhost:8080
- Reverb WebSockets: ws://localhost:8085
- Mailpit UI: http://localhost:8025

Seeded User Credentials:
- Acme Owner: learner.den5556@gmail.com / password
- Acme Admin: khrehmanwaheed@gmail.com / password
- Platform Super Admin: rehman5556@gmail.com / password (is_platform_admin = true)

Tip for Realtime / Broadcast Auth:
Run '0. Authentication -> View Login Page' followed by 'Login as Acme Owner' (or Acme Admin) first so Postman stores your session cookie and automatically extracts {{csrf_token}}.

item.description: Session-based authentication, CSRF token extraction, seeded role logins, invalid credential defense, and Google OAuth 2.0 entry point.

item.name: 2. Multi-Tenant Workspace (v1 API)
item.description: Endpoints for inspecting active tenant workspaces and testing strict multi-tenancy resolution & isolation.

request.description: Resolves the tenant workspace using the `X-Tenant-Slug` header (default: `acme`). Automatically updates `{{tenant_id}}`.
Resolves the tenant workspace using the numeric `X-Tenant-ID` header.
Verifies multi-tenant isolation by fetching the seeded `cyberdyne` workspace (Free plan, monitor_limit: 5).
Confirms fail-closed tenancy returns HTTP 404 when a tenant slug does not exist.

item.name: 3. Monitors (v1 API)
item.description: Tenant-scoped endpoint health monitors protected by pessimistic DB row locking for quota enforcement.

request.description: Lists all monitors scoped to the active tenant (`{{tenant_slug}}`). Automatically sets `{{monitor_id}}` to the first monitor's ID.
Creates a new monitor with default interval (60s) and expected status (200).

item.name: 6. Laravel Reverb Realtime & War Room Chat
item.description: Live WebSocket demo routes, real-time monitor heartbeat trigger, Incident War Room team chat, and Reverb private channel authentication.
